pool.title: I Built My Own Software Factory with Claude Code
pool.description: Most of us still babysit our AI coding agents. Every prompt, every file, every test goes through us. So I built a software factory instead. I write a ticket in Linear, and the agents figure out the rest on their own, while I only step in when it actually matters. In this video I show you how that works, why you still need to stay in control, and how I built mine with Claude Code, T3 Code and PStac
pool.editorial_reason: Write a ticket and agents carry it through, with a human stepping in only at key points.
pool.headline: A Linear-ticket-driven agent pipeline built on Claude Code
